desc: 珊瑚小雏菊全棉菱形折叠壳，自立不贴嘴，包边软耳带可水洗
leaf: 儿童小码全棉菱形折叠立体印花可水洗口罩
name: 儿童全棉菱形立体印花可洗口罩款

shots.intent: 首屏用珊瑚相框＋幽灵大字＋白圆台立住「清爽棉布立体小口罩」的第一印象，一眼看清菱形折叠壳与满版小雏菊印花，拿下详情页点击。
shots.textZone: upper-left: coral pill badge with rosette, headline plus one sub-line; one row of three coral pill labels beneath

shots.intent: 用两格静物把普通布罩塌软贴脸、硬细绳勒耳的日常不适摆成可见物件，再让本款菱形壳自己撑住，制造替换动机，全程不出现人脸与病理叙事。
shots.textZone: headline above the pair, one coral pill label inside each cell

shots.intent: 低机位仰拍下颌弧线，把包边缝线与中缝立骨讲成看得见的做工，回应塌陷与毛边疑虑。
shots.textZone: one coral pill badge plus one short ink label in the upper corner

shots.intent: 两排同框侧剖对照贴脸的扁布与本款自立空腔，用白色气流箭头把呼吸通道画成可见结构，不宣称任何过滤效率。
shots.textZone: two row headers plus one pill label per row, ghosted Latin word behind

shots.intent: 90 度俯视微距看印花跨过中缝的对位与棉布织纹密度，把花型与面料质感讲成可核对的细节。
shots.textZone: one short ink label and one coral pill chip in a clean corner

shots.intent: 以浅水盘与棉布样片把可水洗、不易变形讲成静物证据，资质与参数留白带待真实资料后期合成，绝不编造数字。
shots.textZone: headline on the ribbed band, three coral pill labels beneath, one entirely blank strip in the footer

shots.intent: 耳高机位拍背向人物的耳后与侧缘，让日常佩戴形态自然可见，人物完全匿名、无正脸、无医疗语境。
shots.textZone: clean upper band for one headline plus one short line and one coral pill

shots.intent: 高机位斜俯一次摊开展开与折叠两种形态与可选配色，帮买家判断小码比例与携带方式，不复用同框平铺套路。
shots.textZone: three short coral pill labels along the ribbed footer band

shots.intent: 回收首屏相框构图，用三条洗护佩戴要点与一枚双色按钮收尾，靠结构与棉布质感推动加购而非任何资质承诺。
shots.textZone: headline above, three rosette-bulleted lines on the card, one coral-to-periwinkle duotone button beneath

style.backgroundSystem: flat pastel colour fields, lilac-white #EDEBF6 as the main ground with one aqua-mint block #8FD3C7 and one periwinkle-indigo block #4B57A9 carrying thin white 30-degree pinstripes; every screen enclosed by a uniform coral #F87C88 picture-frame border inset from the canvas edges; one full-width coral ribbed band with fine horizontal scan-lines; raised cloud-white rounded cards #FBFCFE with a 24px corner radius and one soft offset shadow; one oversized ghosted Latin display word bleeding off the frame edge behind the headline; a white graph-paper tile slab #FBFCFE with #DCE6F0 grid lines plus a white cylinder plinth; one soft botanical leaf shadow on the field; never a gradient plinth, never a scalloped pastel candy board, never a grey paper-sticker board, never a clinical or tiled space
style.direction: fresh cotton kids daily-wear framed-poster ecommerce
style.iconSystem: one 6-petal daisy rosette glyph drawn as a 2px outline with three satellite dots, always seated in a white circle capping the right end of a coral #F87C88 pill badge; feature icons reuse the same rosette in deep ink #2B2B33 outline with coral dots and one white circle marker beneath; identical stroke weight everywhere; never an open thin-line circle icon on a gradient disc, never a filled disc icon inside an arch-topped card, never a solid rounded-square badge
style.lightingSystem: neutral 5000K studio light, soft front-left key with a warm coral bounce off the frame edge, clean short shadows falling to the rear-right, one soft diffused leaf shadow on the field, no light streak, no specular hotspot, identical direction across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh cotton kids daily-wear framed-poster ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-white cards #FBFCFE over a lilac-white ground #EDEBF6, one aqua-mint block #8FD3C7, one periwinkle-indigo block #4B57A9 with thin white 30-degree pinstripes, deep ink text #2B2B33, and one coral-pink frame and pill accent #F87C88; neutral 5000K studio light with a soft front-left key, a warm coral bounce off the frame edge and clean short shadows falling to the rear-right, plus one soft botanical leaf shadow on the field, no light streak and no specular hotspot; every screen enclosed by a uniform coral #F87C88 picture-frame border inset from the canvas edges, with one full-width coral ribbed band carrying fine horizontal scan-lines, raised cloud-white rounded cards with a 24px corner radius and one soft offset shadow, a white graph-paper tile slab with #DCE6F0 grid lines and a white cylinder plinth, and one oversized ghosted Latin display word bleeding off the edge behind the headline, never a gradient plinth, never a scalloped pastel candy board, never a grey paper-sticker board, never a clinical space; heavy square Chinese display sans with tight tracking plus small widely-tracked uppercase Latin captions; one 2px daisy rosette outline glyph seated in a white circle capping each coral pill badge, never open thin-line circle icons on gradient discs, never filled disc icons in arch-topped cards, never solid rounded-square badges; real combed-cotton plain-weave fabric rendering; the diamond-folded child-scale cotton mask keeps its angular pointed crown, single vertical centre crease seam, outward cheek wings, curved chin edge, coral #F4899A ground with the all-over white #FFFFFF daisy micro print, tonal overlock bound edges, nose wire hidden inside the crown seam and flat white woven elastic ear loops, with no pleats and no ultrasonic weld dots; stable product scale, angle and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no percentage, particle, layer-count, grammage, size figure or code rendered, no medical or clinical framing.
noDrift: no color palette changes
no mixed fonts
no random backgrounds
no inconsistent lighting
no mismatched icon styles
no blue gradient field or 3D stepped plinth ground; the set is a flat lilac-white field inside a coral picture-frame border with ribbed bands and rounded cards
no scalloped pastel candy colour-block boards and no cream paper board; this palette is coral, lilac-white, aqua-mint and periwinkle-indigo
no mist-grey paper-sticker board, no letterspaced uppercase kicker line and no rotated vertical Latin label; the Latin element is one oversized ghosted display word bleeding off the edge
no warm 4300K front-right key, no 5200K top-right key and no 6000K top-left light streak; the set is neutral 5000K with a soft front-left key and a coral bounce

no thin-line circle icons on gradient discs, no filled disc icons in arch-topped cards and no solid rounded-square badges; icons stay 2px daisy rosette glyphs inside a white circle capping a coral pill
no filtration percentage of any kind, including 95 percent, 98 percent, 99 percent, BFE or PFE
no PM2.5 or particle-size figure and no strong-filtration, low-resistance-filtration, filter-media or breathability-efficiency wording, rendered or implied
no comparative claim that another mask type is unsafe or ineffective and no material-name salesline
no layer-count or ply claim, no grammage figure in g per square metre, no thickness or size figure such as an unfolded millimetre width rendered as text
no non-toxic, antibacterial, antiviral, allergen-free, hypoallergenic or eco-certified claim
no pathogen, virus, bacteria, germ, dust-harm or disease claim and no health-threat narrative about children
no medical, surgical, clinical, isolation or healthcare wording anywhere
no standard or grade code such as KN95, N95, GB 2626, YY 0469 or EN 14683
no test report, laboratory figure, certification mark, seal text or blank credential seal artwork
no clinical setting, hospital, clinic or healthcare worker
no identifiable human face; any wearer is cropped above the jaw or turned away, and no child face appears on camera
no QR code, membership corner flag, free-for-members badge, contact block, price or discount
no pleats, no exposed nose clip, no ultrasonic weld dots, no valve, no cartridge and no cartoon character or brand mark added to the body
no change to the diamond fold, bound edge, ear-loop construction, woven cotton hand, print motif or colour
style.presentationRules: keep the diamond-folded child-scale 3D form with its angular pointed crown, one single vertical centre crease seam, outward cheek wings, curved chin edge, coral #F4899A ground carrying the all-over white #FFFFFF daisy micro print, tonal overlock bound edges, the nose wire hidden inside the crown seam with no exposed clip, and the flat white woven elastic ear loops; no pleats, no ultrasonic weld dots, no valve, no cartridge, no logo printed on the body; identical print motif, scale, density and orientation in every shot; stable angle, scale and centring
style.surfaceSystem: matte cloud-white card planes #FBFCFE with a soft-touch sheen, one white graph-paper tile slab with #DCE6F0 grid lines, one white cylinder plinth, matte painted board; the product itself is real combed-cotton plain-weave woven cloth with an overlock bound edge, never spun-bonded non-woven
style.typography: heavy square Chinese display sans with tight tracking for headlines, plus one oversized ghosted Latin display word set behind the headline and cropped by the frame edge, and small widely-tracked uppercase Latin captions under the icons; three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline <=15 chars, two to five short coral pill labels, no dense body text, no figures rendered by the model
